final: WITH g AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client GROUP BY district_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.district_id, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total) IS NULL, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total DESC LIMIT 10
